typography.notes: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif for headings. Emphasize elegance and tension with Cormorant Garamond for headings and Amiri for Arabic/calligraphic titles.

colors.notes: Deep ink/charcoal background for an archival feel. Gold/calligraphy accents. No bright neon colors.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the background to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'archive' aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders with 10% opacity (border-white/10) to separate sections without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadow. Prefer sharp, crisp boundaries or very soft, dark diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full-screen glossy gradients. Use radial gradients strictly for soft spotlighting behind key elements (like the book or the map dot).

components.header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0C10]/70. 1px bottom border border-white/10.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular, bordered with primary_accent (Gold), transparent background, hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#0B0C10] transition-colors duration-300.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces (bg-[#13151A]) with 1px border-white/10, no heavy drop shadow. Use neo-brutalist or minimalist archival spacing.

layouts.hero: Kinetic hero. Large typography with line-by-line masked reveal on load (framer-motion). Subtle parallax background image of Islamic calligraphy with bg-black/60 overlay so text is highly readable.
layouts.author_section: Immersive scroll-triggered section. The author's representation (manuscript texture) fades and translates up on scroll. Text beside it details his legacy.
layouts.map_and_timeline: A vertical timeline drawing down as the user scrolls. Marks 1292 to 1350. Next to it, an SVG map or antique map image with a pulsing gold dot (Framer Motion scale + opacity animation) specifically placed on Damascus, Syria.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Numbered manifesto chapters using a Bento grid ('The Tetris Grid'). Asymmetrical, mixing tall and wide cards to break monotony.
layouts.book_showcase: The book ('Les Méditations') slides up and floats on scroll. Includes a reader/excerpt section mimicking turning pages or elegant text layout.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. Serif font, uppercase, separated by gold bullets. E.g., 'SAGESSE • SPIRITUALITÉ • MÉDITATIONS • PATRIMOINE ISLAMIQUE'. Use react-fast-marquee.
layouts.order_form: Clean, minimal Shadcn-based form with custom styling (dark backgrounds, gold borders on focus) for ordering the book.

motion.scroll: Mandatory use of @studio-freight/lenis for momentum scrolling.
motion.animations: Framer Motion for all reveal effects. Line-by-line text reveals (using overflow-hidden wrappers and y-axis translation). Parallax on images. Staggered reveals for Bento grid items.
motion.hover: Subtle scale-up (scale-105) for images, opacity shifts for text links, inverted colors for buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text_primary and text_secondary meet APCA standards against the dark background.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must use ring-2 ring-[#D4AF37].
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='order-button').

images.description: Elegant Islamic calligraphy in gold on a modern black wall. Use as the hero parallax background with heavy dark overlay.
Ancient arabic calligraphy on parchment. Use as a textural element or masked shape for the author section to represent Ibn al-Qayyim.
Antique map texture. Use as a background for the Damascus map section, blending with SVG elements.
A collection of Arabic books arranged vertically on a black background. Representing the book 'Les Méditations'.
Vintage leather-bound books. Used in the excerpt/consultation section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a one-page scroll experience (landing page) for the Islamic book 'Les Méditations' by Ibn al-Qayyim.
Install and setup @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling. Wrap the app in a Lenis provider.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to achieve asymmetry. Do not rely entirely on rigid Shadcn Cards for the main narrative flow.
Use Shadcn strictly for the Order Form (Input, Form, Button, Select).
Hero Section: Implement a kinetic text reveal. Text must be wrapped in hidden overflow containers and slide up via Framer Motion on mount.

Timeline & Map: Create a visually striking scroll-linked timeline. Use an SVG or the provided antique map image with a pulsing absolute-positioned dot (animated with Framer Motion) to indicate Damascus.
Book Reveal: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform to make the book image translate into the viewport smoothly as the user reaches the section.
Typography: Apply Cormorant Garamond for main headings (h1, h2) and Manrope for body text. Use Amiri for any Arabic script or decorative subheadings.
No generic centering: Align text based on optical balance, use generous padding (p-12, p-16, p-24) to let the design breathe.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Always use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js if needed.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
